## Security verdict: PASS WITH NOTES

PR #167, exact head `afa8659318d1663dd9af27e5f24be5d91ba65b00`.

Reviewed only `9cdcf3d..afa8659` and the tightly dependent admission/mark/send flow. No new high-confidence security vulnerability was identified.

| # | Severity | File | Lines | Vulnerability | Confidence |
|---|----------|------|-------|---------------|------------|
| - | - | - | - | No new vulnerability identified | - |

### Veto and authority evidence

`crates/store/src/compactions.rs:125-156` atomically marks the exact pending `(seat,msg_id)` only when no same-seat, strictly higher database-sequence pending row exists. A failed or vetoed mark authorizes no send (`crates/daemon/src/compaction_wake.rs:109-122,245-264`). Other-seat rows cannot veto.

Existing pane/process resolution and compact-policy checks precede recording; the original target and message remain attached to admission (`crates/daemon/src/http/mod.rs:2460-2557`). Insert-only `(seat,msg_id)` deduplication prevents replay from creating a newer veto or rearming settled history (`crates/store/src/compactions.rs:25-47`).

Owned writes survive waiter cancellation and serialize through `BEGIN IMMEDIATE` (`crates/store/src/migrate.rs:47-56,267-273`). A newer row committed before the mark vetoes it without settling the old row. This transaction does not lock the later send against subsequent admissions.

Delivery, activity, idle, queue and holdings guards remain unchanged, as do the fixed resume body and subject/live-parent recipients (`compaction_wake.rs:127-243,291-325`). No new payload, privacy or secret-injection path was identified. Prior C32 registration-strength and C19/C21 findings remain unchanged.

### Retained limitations

A post-record refusal/cancellation can leave a ghost pending row that delays older wakes until the existing one-hour undelivered bound. Read failures can prolong waiting. Mark-before-send loss is still unretried, settled IDs remain non-rearming, and the rewritten intermediate migration-0044 checksum caveat is unchanged. This security verdict does not clear those reliability/deployment limitations or prove atomic delivery.

### Proof

GitHub metadata and the independent remote pull ref agree on the full reviewed SHA; GitHub reports CLEAN. CI run `42425691985` and latest successful Delivers run `42425694625` both identify this exact SHA and success; the earlier cancelled Delivers run is superseded.

No local builds, tests, probes, fault injection, credential reads or runtime compactions/wakes were performed. The veto and boundaries were source-reviewed; exact-head CI is the execution proof.
